tiers.summary: Robert Sánchez parried Casemiro's shot from inside the area in the first minute, and United won a corner in the 3rd minute after Levi Colwill put the ball out. The rest of the opening spell was quiet, and it stayed 0–0.

Reece James gave Chelsea the lead in the 28th minute with a left-footed finish after an error by Diogo Dalot. Liam Delap then shot wide in the 30th minute; Chelsea led 1–0.
Chelsea had most of the ball in the 32nd and 33rd minutes, and Senne Lammens parried a left-footed shot from Andrey Santos in the 35th. Chelsea led 1–0.

United's Bruno Fernandes and Matthijs de Ligt shot off target, and United won two corners late in the period. Chelsea led 1–0 after 40 minutes.

Bruno Fernandes was booked for a foul on Adarabioyo in stoppage time. Chelsea led 1–0 at half-time, with five attempts each, three on target for Chelsea to United's two, and possession at 51% to 49%.

Kobbie Mainoo was shown a second yellow card for a foul on Pedro Neto in the 52nd minute, reducing United to ten men, and Senne Lammens then parried an Enzo Fernández shot. Diogo Dalot shot off target in the 54th minute; Chelsea led 1–0.

Benjamin Šeško equalised for United in the 61st minute with a left-footed finish. Chelsea had most of the ball afterwards without a shot, and it was 1–1.

Reece James restored Chelsea's lead in the 67th minute with a left-footed finish. Senne Lammens then parried two Tosin Adarabioyo shots in the 69th minute, the second a big chance after a Lisandro Martínez error; Chelsea led 2–1.

Chelsea had most of the ball in the 72nd and 73rd minutes, and Senne Lammens parried an Enzo Fernández shot in the 73rd minute before Enzo shot off target in the 74th. Andrey Santos also shot from inside the area in the 75th minute; Chelsea led 2–1.
Senne Lammens parried a big chance from Reece James in the 77th minute. Benjamin Šeško was booked for a foul on Tosin Adarabioyo in the 80th minute; Chelsea led 2–1.
